faults.name: Gearbox overheating
causes: Low gearbox oil level or degraded oil
Blocked oil cooler or failed cooling fan
Excessive friction from worn gears or bearings
checks: Check gearbox oil level and oil condition
Inspect the oil cooler and cooling fan operation
Take an oil sample and look for metal particles

faults.name: Bearing wear
checks: Inspect bearing lubrication and grease condition
Run a vibration analysis on the drivetrain

faults.name: Generator overheating
causes: Electrical overload or winding insulation problem
checks: Inspect generator cooling fan and air filters
Review recent power output for overload

faults.name: Excessive vibration
causes: Blade imbalance, for example ice, dirt or damage
checks: Inspect blades for ice, damage or dirt
Check bolt tightness on the nacelle and tower
Compare vibration at different rotor speeds
